UXUC80E is a specific medical procedure code used in the Danish healthcare system to designate transthoracic echocardiography with tissue Doppler imaging. It plays a critical role in the national quality measurement and monitoring of diagnostic practices for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. As part of the standardized data collection efforts coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code ensures that specific cardiac imaging procedures are accurately tracked in health registries to evaluate the quality of care [^src1].

In the context of clinical quality indicators, UXUC80E is officially recognized as one of the valid codes for [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] [^src2]. The indicator area for echocardiography encompasses a specific set of procedure codes, including [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]], [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], UXUC80E, [[uxuc81|UXUC81]], and [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] [^src1]. By capturing these specific codes, Danish health authorities can calculate precise metrics regarding the timeliness and completeness of diagnostic workups for atrial fibrillation patients across different regions.
